TABLE.NAME: tool_reportbuilder
TABLE.COMMENT: Each report has an entry here

FIELD.NAME: id
FIELD.COMMENT: ID of the table

FIELD.NAME: name
FIELD.COMMENT: Title of report, displayed on page and used to refer to a report instance

FIELD.NAME: idnumber
FIELD.COMMENT: Unique ID used internally as a unique way of identifying a report

FIELD.NAME: source
FIELD.COMMENT: Data source on which the report is based

FIELD.NAME: description
FIELD.COMMENT: Description of the report

FIELD.NAME: type
FIELD.COMMENT: The type of the report

FIELD.NAME: conditions
FIELD.COMMENT: Conditions to apply

FIELD.NAME: usercreated
FIELD.COMMENT: The user who created this request object

FIELD.NAME: usermodified
FIELD.COMMENT: The user who created/modified this request object

FIELD.NAME: timecreated
FIELD.COMMENT: The time this data request was created

FIELD.NAME: timemodified
FIELD.COMMENT: The last time this data request was updated

TABLE.NAME: tool_reportbuilder_column
TABLE.COMMENT: Defines columns belonging to each report

FIELD.NAME: reportid
FIELD.COMMENT: ID of the report this column belongs to

FIELD.NAME: entity
FIELD.COMMENT: Entity of the column (user, course...)

FIELD.NAME: name
FIELD.COMMENT: Value of column, used with type to identify the column option

FIELD.NAME: aggregate
FIELD.COMMENT: Aggregation type, null means none

FIELD.NAME: heading
FIELD.COMMENT: Visible heading describing the column to report users

FIELD.NAME: columnorder
FIELD.COMMENT: Order in which columns appear in the report

FIELD.NAME: sortenabled
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether the sorting is enabled for the column

FIELD.NAME: sortdirection
FIELD.COMMENT: Sort direction (SORT_ASC or SORT_DESC)

FIELD.NAME: sortorder
FIELD.COMMENT: Order of the column in the sort sequence (ORDER BY)

FIELD.NAME: usermodified
FIELD.COMMENT: The user who created/modified this request object

FIELD.NAME: timecreated
FIELD.COMMENT: The time this data request was created

FIELD.NAME: timemodified
FIELD.COMMENT: The last time this data request was updated
